basic_details.job_title: Govt Raja Mirasdar Hospital Thanjavur Optometry Technician Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.notification_number: Notification dated 23.10.2026 (Medical and Rural Health Services, Thanjavur District)

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | optometry technician: Diploma in Optometry

salary_details.details: The official notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits beyond the monthly consolidated salary.

how_to_apply: Go to the Thanjavur district official website at thanjavur.nic.in to download the application form.
Print the application form and fill in all required details in Tamil and English as specified.
Affix a passport-size photograph in the designated space on the application form.
Gather self-attested copies of all required certificates including marks statements, date of birth proof, identity proof, and experience certificates.
Enclose all self-attested document copies along with the filled application form.
Submit the completed application either in person or through post to the designated address on or before 23 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: All offered positions are entirely temporary and contractual. No post will be made permanent under any circumstances. Upon completion of 11 months, a 1-day break in service will be applied before issuing a re-appointment order. Applications received after 5:00 PM on 23.10.2026 will be summarily rejected. Incomplete applications or applications without proper supporting certificates and self-attestations will be rejected. Applications can be submitted either in person or by post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for the Optometry Technician post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Government Raja Mirasdar Hospital, Thanjavur under the Department of Medical and Rural Health Services.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Govt Raja Mirasdar Hospital Thanjavur Optometry Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Optometry Technician post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application is 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Optometry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for the Optometry Technician post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 12,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely temporary and on a contract basis for 11 months with a 1-day break in service before renewal, and no post will be made permanent.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official website, attach self-attested copies of required certificates, and submit it in person or by post to the Principal, Government Raja Mirasdar Hospital, Thanjavur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the address to send the application?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Principal, Government Raja Mirasdar Hospital, Thanjavur, with the contact phone number 04362 – 231221.
